items.summary: Reintroduce a blue primary action style across the Product Editor experience so primary buttons (e.g., “Generate”, “Generate All Products”) render with a clearly blue background (not purple) and readable contrast in both light and dark themes by updating the global theme tokens in frontend/src/index.css.

Fix the Product Editor page background/surface styling so it does not appear “completely white”; restore an accented/surfaced look (subtle tint/gradient or muted panel treatment) consistent with the app theme when viewing the product editor workspace and editor card(s) (frontend/src/components/products/ProductsWorkspace.tsx and frontend/src/components/products/ProductEditor.tsx).

Make the onboarding/popup Instructions window fully opaque and easy to read by updating frontend/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingInstructionsModal.tsx to apply a solid background and appropriate border/shadow styling to the DialogContent (avoid transparent/translucent content that reduces legibility).
